description: Invite a person to a CarlNotes team you belong to, or to a topic you edit, by their username or their email address. An email invite sends an email and counts toward a daily limit. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to invite someone, invite a friend to my team, or share this topic with a person.

email.description: The person's email address, in place of username.

team_id.description: The team to invite to, in place of topic_id.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.

name: send_invite
title: Invite someone
